title: Unit evaluation and signed braiding for the canonical site tensor comparison
statement: For any finite commutative ring B (including the zero ring) and scheme T (including the empty scheme), write E for the exact ordinary-etale to pro-etale derived inverse image and t: E(Z⊗K)≅EZ⊗EK, u:E(1)≅1 for the canonical comparisons [def-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transport-data]. For every e:Z→1, E((e⊗id)≫λ)=t≫((E(e)≫u)⊗id)≫λ. For every M,N, E(β_M,N)≫t_N,M=t_M,N≫β_EM,EN, with the canonical signed derived braidings.

source.place: Proof (3), finite-ring tensor formula; explicit site transport steps of lem-pur-finite-ring-site-tensor-transpose

proof.text: On K-flat flat-term representatives the tensor comparison is induced by the ordinary inverse-image pure-tensor map, and the unit comparison by the ordinary scalar unit. In each bidegree scalar evaluation and exchange of factors agree, with identical sign (-1)^(ab). The bidegree summands generate the direct-sum total tensor complex. The exact/derived comparison identifies the resulting localized chain-map equalities with the specified maps.
